changes: Added Electron Builder configuration for Windows x64 NSIS and macOS arm64 DMG/ZIP.
Added manual GitHub Actions release workflow.
Added secure preload IPC for update actions.
Added update service with SemVer comparison and autoDownload disabled.
Added UI indicator and modal for available updates.
Added macOS Alpha manual download/install fallback.
known_risks: Private GitHub Releases require authentication; the app intentionally does not embed GitHub tokens.
The Python runtime must be prepared before official builds so .venv can be bundled as an extra resource.
Local NSIS installer generation timed out while packing the large Python runtime; the unpacked Windows app was generated.
macOS automatic replacement is intentionally disabled until Developer ID signing and notarization exist.
Windows and macOS signing are not configured because no certificates were provided.
